title: Affected proof planner
root_cause: Repairs repeatedly run either too little downstream proof or premature broad certification instead of a computed transitive cone.
source_requirement: Plan minimum sufficient focused, affected, section, and stale-evidence proof from change class, dependency invalidation, and test ownership.
implementation_steps: Map nodes to focused/affected tests and governed sections.
List stale evidence/projections and completion rules.
negative_cases: Focused green closes card with consumers.
affected_tests: Test ownership, section runner, and dependency invalidation tests.
evidence_required: Deterministic plan vectors and complete cone comparison.
rollback: Fall back to conservative explicit affected lists; do not run broad certification during repair.
acceptance_criteria: Every changed card receives focused, negative, affected, and section proof.
Cards with consumers cannot close before downstream green.
